How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Juvenile Justice Board Sivaganga Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.sivagangai.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Juvenile Justice Board Sivaganga recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Juvenile Justice Board Sivaganga recruitment is 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Ethnic Status Assistant and Register Clerk / Office Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for these posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant post is 8th standard or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all applicants is 42 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Ethnic Status Assistant and Register Clerk post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Ethnic Status Assistant and Register Clerk post is Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Office Assistant post is Rs. 13,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website www.sivagangai.nic.in.
